description: Basic Docker registry, image and labeling presets. Extends the digest pinning already applied in default.json (opt-in).

packageRules.description: These registries don't expose timestamps. Since Renovate 42, missing timestamps are treated as not yet past minimumReleaseAge, causing updates to be permanently pending (no PR, visible in Dependency Dashboard). https://docs.renovatebot.com/key-concepts/minimum-release-age/#which-registries-support-release-timestamps
Label non-major Docker image updates without grouping (use docker-extended for grouping)
Major Docker image updates as individual PRs to review breaking changes separately
